scope: First-round global mythology architecture and evidence baseline
strategy: Parallel authoritative-source discovery plus deterministic seed ingestion
agent_or_process: Codex primary agent with three parallel sub-agents
notes: No claim of global completeness; queue continues expansion.

scope: Typhon and Metis; Norse genealogy, Mímir and divine smiths; early wuxing text locations
strategy: Queue-priority selection; primary and scholarly digital editions; witness-specific claims; no destructive merges
notes: Stage baseline only; permanent queue continues. Dedup audit redirected five migration-2 wuxing component IDs to pre-existing baseline canonical IDs; claims and evidence now resolve to the originals.

scope: Community-requested Greek deity gap, first-ring genealogy, Homeric Hymns 2/29/31/32 and family-graph baseline
strategy: Treat community feedback as discovery only; verify all claims against primary digital texts; preserve source layers and unresolved identities
notes: Expandable staged baseline only. Hecate later layers, Nyx extended genealogy, cult evidence and Perses identity remain in the permanent queue.

scope: Greek core deity primary-text profiles, Homeric Hymn subworks, artifacts, mythic events and explicit Aphrodite genealogy variants
strategy: Use exact ancient-text locators; distinguish textual witness from historical reality; preserve variants and feed uncovered layers back into the permanent queue
notes: Expandable staged baseline only. Olympian membership, Eleusinian archaeology, Hermes staff history, Hades helm and Hephaestus variants remain open.

scope: Thor family and Loki reception correction; evidence-led thunder, lightning and storm comparison across Norse, Greek, Vedic, Japanese, Chinese, Slavic, Yoruba and Ugaritic traditions
strategy: Use ancient or medieval text witnesses, academic editions, museums, official heritage records and community-backed living-tradition dossiers; require a located claim for every comparison member; preserve titles, umbrella figures, variants, restricted knowledge and modern adaptations as separate layers
agent_or_process: Codex research agents and persistent data pipeline
notes: Expandable staged baseline only. Regional Raijin, Vajra reception, Perun archaeology, Sango permissions, Baal genealogy/Mot cycle and wider Thor sibling variants remain in the permanent queue.

scope: Egyptian solar forms, composite deities, Karnak and Abu Simbel cult-site evidence, museum objects, funerary-text journey and the public Opet layer
strategy: Start from permanent NEW queue targets; prioritize peer-reviewed Egyptology, official Egyptian monuments, UNESCO, museum catalogues and a university digital text; preserve components, variants and archaeological reality as separate layers
notes: Expandable staged baseline only. Wider composite deities, Heliopolitan chronology, Opet inscriptions, Khepri iconography, Abu Simbel conservation and Theban triad variants remain queued.

scope: Eleusis archaeology, public ritual layer, Homeric Hymn evidence, I.Eleusis 97 and Great Eleusinian Relief object network
strategy: Select the highest-value source-found queue target; prioritize primary text, epigraphy, Greek official archaeology and museum catalogues; preserve uncertainty and secrecy boundaries
notes: Expandable staged baseline only. Inscription corpus, architecture phases, Sacred Way segments, Ninnion Tablet, copy network and terminology remain queued.

scope: Perses homonym identity audit across Hesiod, Pseudo-Apollodorus, Diodorus and Herodotus
strategy: Advance the highest-priority executable conflict queue target; compare parentage, siblings and narrative role before identity assessment; never merge by spelling
notes: Three major Perses figures are explicitly separated. Additional scholia, fragments and later witnesses remain queued.

scope: Japanese regional thunder-kami, Kamo genealogy, Kamigamo living heritage and Sotatsu visual reception
strategy: Official shrine and museum records, UNESCO heritage metadata and university academic references; separate witness, ritual and visual layers
notes: Local failures would be audited without blocking unrelated work; no restricted ritual material was collected.

scope: Ptah-Sokar-Osiris composite identity, dated funerary figures, object contents, custody and interpretive limits
strategy: Start from permanent priority-99 Egyptian syncretism queue; use official museum object catalogues; keep components, observed material, hypothesis and modern custody distinct
notes: Expandable staged baseline only. Primary texts, cult history, typology, inscriptions, technical analysis and Ra-Atum remain queued.

scope: Atum-Ra and Atum-Horakhty composite expressions, Chapter 15 sun hymn, Darius Susa statue and rising/setting solar comparison

notes: Expandable staged baseline only. Older composite witnesses, manuscript variants, inscription editions, provenance and museum inventory remain queued.
